# datadog_status_page (Data Source)

Use this data source to retrieve information about an existing Datadog status page.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "datadog_status_page" "example" {
  id = "ba32b61d-ba85-45b3-9976-fcc39e808351"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the status page.

### Read-Only

- `domain_prefix` (String) The domain prefix for the status page URL.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the status page is published/enabled.
- `name` (String) The name of the status page.
- `page_url` (String) The URL of the status page.
- `type` (String) The type of status page (`public` or `internal`).
- `visualization_type` (String) How component status is visualized.
